EPS.CLI: python3 -I -B MODULE --spec SPEC --out NEW_JSON [--mode eps|rho] [--settings registered|smoke] [--shells JSON]
EPS.adapter_result: proof (UNT_CALIBRATION_POINT_PROOF_CX2V001) and driver_certificate (pinned numeric JSON) are distinct; no self hash
EPS.context_API: point_context(spec): derives pinned custody and original-module 4-node reference check
EPS.envelope: point-dependent cardinal torus 12^3 x 200 hemisphere x 3 radii + local search; selected 20^3 x 400 x 5 audit; values are numerical estimates, NOT supremum enclosures
EPS.full_coverage: unit shells from 4 to ceil(sqrt(2)*Kbig); omission of --shells selects every shell
EPS.registered_rule: 26/52/104 directions at 64/128/256 radii per decade; one further refinement allowed; refined <=1.1 base

review_required.numeric_ref: exact path+sha of full numeric record

EPS.review_trust: Review bytes and both producer hashes must be independently approved outside the record; smoke/subset always rejected.

cap_required.component_column_TV_mass_caps_kg: nonnegative components x all radial columns matrix, actual proper-source mass
cap_required.component_names: all registered source slots; exact runtime roster set

LO.current_driver_adapter: UNAVAILABLE: no current-state proof adapter was fabricated; required LO guard fields include full state, row_contract_sha256, i1t_verdict, independently supplied GQ_uniform_proof_sha256, shell max_over_tau and summed_max_over_tau
LO.enforcement_gap: Function is supplied and adversarially tested; integration into every actual source construction/consumption and distinct review are still UNTESTED. No caps have been scientifically adopted by this helper.
LO.independent_checks: TailState.from_arrays(expected_digest); normalized config SHA; actual certificate slots; exact kp/kz/wkp/wz array values; domain/jet order; source/stage hashes; recomputed B1 from saved P/F and angular domain; I1-T; row order/radii/tau; source reconstruction trust boundary

input_required.row_reference: byte reference to actual-source/readout row record
input_required.source_reconstruction: byte reference to independently approved reconstruction record

state.state_sha256: TailState digest from original record plus every array

tail_state.arrays: byte reference to complete NPZ arrays
tail_state.record: byte reference to TailState record JSON

LO.root_0528: Missing own-run state/source -> certificate UNAVAILABLE, point INCOMPLETE; missing prelaunch reviewed/enforced caps -> UNAVAILABLE, NOT_ADMITTED; fresh calls only, no resume/retry, interrupted route-A invalid.

row_required.policy_review: byte reference in independent reviewed allowlist, APPROVED and exact row_contract_sha256
row_required.state_files: original own-run readout source archives with byte pins

LO.signed_GQ: CONSERVATIVE_FINITE_DENOMINATOR; normalization implemented by parent GQ lane, not this source-TV LO bound. No max-component-mass substitution.
LO.source_majorant: c^2 sum_i |Pi_i(kperp)| sum_c M_ci_max/(2*pi*rdr_i) + c^2 a_star |P_star(kperp)|; NOT c^2 times total gas mass. Valid for arbitrary z phases and signed component mixtures with TV caps.

source_reconstruction_required.producer: byte reference in independent approved allowlist
source_reconstruction_required.source_files: all original own-run saved-state archives, path+sha; static dependency pins separate

LO.state_reconstruction_boundary: Array digest integrity alone cannot establish source truth. An approved source producer must replay P/F and rows from original own-run source arrays and certify complete source custody.
